notes.title: Boss Defiance - Heroic Edition available now!
notes.content:
Hey there fighters! Boss Defiance gets today a major update with the release of the Heroic Edition here on Steam! After a long silence, we're happy to announce that TinyPixel's action arcade game has now been revamped, polished & refreshed as part of ReLaunch publishing program from Gamera Interactive. All the players already owning the original game will receive the Heroic Edition update for free. 

The update comes with a 28 pages Concept Book along with 2 new in-game characters: the Pyromancer, mastering art of fire-crafting and the Alchemist, using potions to heal its mates or to bring great damage to the enemies!

The game works great with Steam Remote Play for your summer nights playing online with your friends!

notes.title: Build 1.0.6 with Chinese now available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have just made public a new version of the PC version of Boss Defiance, build 1.0.6.This patch will be applied by Steam automatically when you next start the game.
The patch solves some issues and add new features:

[h1]Bug & Fix[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Achievement Last Man Standing was not working: now you should be able to unlock it
    [*]Minor fixes 
[/list]

[h1]Chinese Language available[/h1]
[list]
    [*]You can now play the game in chinese! Just change the language to use from the settings. Thanks to Allen Fang fort he translation
[/list]


Should you find any bug or if you have any suggestions, write us!

Thank you and have a great time!

notes.title: Update: build 1.0.5 live now
notes.content:
We have just made public a new version of the PC version of Boss Defiance, build 1.0.5.This patch will be applied by Steam automatically when you next start the game.
The patch solves some issues and add new features:

[h1]Bug & Fix[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed residual bug with achievements that were not unlocking. This problem has been finally resolved.
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Custom Control Mapping Save: from now on, if you change the custom control mapping, they will be saved and not re-inserted each time. This is particullary useful is you use keyboard control for playing.
[*] Updated light graphics: we detected a problem with light management. We resolved it and added new lights to give more mood and feeling to the game.

[/list]

notes.title: Important Update: build 1.0.3 live now
notes.content:
We have just made public a new version of the PC version of Boss Defiance, build 1.0.3.This patch will be applied by Steam automatically when you next start the game.
The patch solves some important issues and add new functionalities:

[h1]Bug & Fix[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Solved bug with Boss health: in 3 players mode and Beast Mode the Boss  health was too low due to a bug and game balancing was not good. The problem has been solved.
    [*]Minor graphic fixes
    [*]Minor UI fixes
[/list]

[h1]New feature: End Game Stats[/h1]
We added simple stats (total damage dealt and total lifetime) for each playble character in Boss Defiance! At the end of each game, a Stat Page will display them. We plan to add more stats in the future.

[h1]Game changes & Balancing[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Balanced the 3 players Mode: the Boss will have a little more health
    [*]Balanced the Beast Mode: the Boss will have a little less health
[/list]

Should you experience any difficulties or If you find any bug, please report it here or at info@tinypixel-studios.com.

Thank you and have fun with Boss Defiance!!

notes.title: Update: build 1.0.2 live now
notes.content:
We have just made public a new version of the PC version of Boss Defiance, build 1.0.2 This patch will be applied by Steam automatically when you next start the game.
The patch solves the following issues:

[h1]Bug & Fix [/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed game issue when mapping custom keyboard controls. Now it is possible to set keyboard control and use them.
    [*]Crystal UI health: fixed small problem with UI
    [*] Minor fix on the UI of the Main Menu
[/list]

[h1]Game changes & Balancing [/h1]
[list]
    [*] Increased the health of Crystal for all game modes
    [*] Medusa Nerf: less hp and less damage with normal attack
    [*] Minotaur Buff: added more hp and more damage when using special 
skill
    [*] Assassin Buff: deals more damage with normal attack
[/list]

We will keep monitoring for feedback and will release further patches when needed. We greatly welcome your feedback!

notes.title: Dev Update#2 - Steam Trading Cards & New Beast Mode
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Only 4 days are left before the game release, and we are super excited!! It's time for news & update about the game:

[b]Beast Mode[/b]
We finished and developed a new game mode for the game, the Beast Mode.
In Beast Mode the Boss will be more powerful than in the Normal Mode: the Boss will have more hp and will do more damage. The Beast Mode is intended for "pro" players or If you want a real challenge!

[b]Steam Cards[/b]
Steam Cards [b]WILL[/b] be present in our game, we already prepared them but due to lack of time probably they will be published AFTER the release of the game. We don't want to postpone the release of the game only for the Steam Cards, but they will be added in the near future.

We'll have some news for you folks before the game release.

Again, thank you for your support. I hope you are ready to play Boss Defiance!

notes.title: Dev Update#1 - Balancing & Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

In this Dev Update we want to inform you about what we are working on right now.
The game is already 100% complete, and what we are doing now is polishing the whole and implementing some features (more languages, ecc). We are also working on the creation of Steam Trading Cards: we hope and think that they will be ready and approved by Steam before our release the 1 of September.

Moreover, we are working on the balancing of the game by doing several play test session: due to his inherently asymmetrical gameplay, balancing is a key role element in the game, and we want it to be as good as possible.

More news to come soon!!
